title: Louisiana 104-location adoption hold: serviceability still lacks subscriber outcomes
publisher: Louisiana Office of Broadband Development and Connectivity
summary: The Nextlink tower makes service available to 104 BEAD locations, but no compatible installed, subscribed, tested, retained, priced, complained, or accepted-closeout results are public for that cohort. Denominator: The same 104 Bossier Parish BEAD locations, followed from serviceability through installation, subscription, performance testing, retention, price, complaint, remediation, and accepted closeout.
key_findings: Evidence stage: Adoption and retention result hold.

Finding: The Nextlink tower makes service available to 104 BEAD locations, but no compatible installed, subscribed, tested, retained, priced, complained, or accepted-closeout results are public for that cohort.

Denominator: The same 104 Bossier Parish BEAD locations, followed from serviceability through installation, subscription, performance testing, retention, price, complaint, remediation, and accepted closeout.
Boundary: Service availability is not installation or subscription.
Boundary: Montana's acceptance controls clarify needed fields but are not Louisiana results.
Boundary: No stable public subscriber or retention denominator is available.
Next action: Reopen with privacy-safe counts for all 104 locations at each adoption and acceptance stage.
